mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.role_id JOIN t_permission p ON p.permission_id=rp.permission_id WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND g.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.role_scope_key=CAST(g.tenant_id AS CHAR) AND g.effective_from <= #{now} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{now}) AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND rp.status='ACTIVE' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.permission_code IN #{code}
